integrity: The symbolic endpoint certificate checks an infinite parameter range by an affine comparison lemma rather than extrapolating from finitely many numerical examples. A published continuation theorem is invoked with its exact hypotheses; no claim of independent validation or exhaustive prior-literature discovery is made.
scientific_limitations: Only f>=8 and g=2f+4 are proved. The all-time extension uses the proved four-block continuation theorem of van Berkel and Bosma. The affine certificate is executable exact integer arithmetic and has not been independently audited. Bibliographic priority is assessed only against inspected and indexed accessible sources.
title: An exact fourth off-diagonal family of greedy 2-sumfree sequences
